title: Load shedding policy matrix (Hosted API) — shed reasons, HTTP mapping, retry guidance, trigger layers
content:
SHEET: Policy Matrix (v0.9)
Owner: Rafael Mendes (SRE)
Last pass: align with ADR-0147 mappings; incorporate streaming caveats + layer ownership.

Legend:
- “Layer(s) that can trigger” indicates where the decision is made; upstream layers should pass-through downstream overload codes when available.
- Overload codes are ONLY for platform-driven shedding. Quota/rate limits use separate codes (not overload.*).
- Headers required for non-streaming overload responses:
  - X-Request-Id
  - X-Redwood-Error-Code
  - X-Redwood-Retryable
  - Retry-After (required when retryable=true AND headers not yet sent)
  - (recommended) X-Redwood-Overload-Layer: edge|routing|runtime

TAB: Policy Matrix
Columns:
error_code	short_name	layer(s) that can trigger	primary trigger signals	common scenarios	http_status (Redwood REST)	openai_compat error.type	retryable	Retry-After required?	default Retry-After guidance (sec)	client guidance (what to do)	can fallback/degrade be applied?	owner team	observability notes

overload.edge_admission_denied	edge admission denied	gateway (edge)	Admission control denies due to regional saturation, control plane protection, or per-tier protection	Step-function traffic spike; surge of long prompts; upstream retry storm	429	rate_limit_error	true	yes	1–3	Respect Retry-After; add jitter; reduce concurrency; if possible switch to smaller prompts/models	Maybe (only if request not pinned + policy allows; typically routing never reached)	API gateway (Platform)	Count as overload-protected; emit admission_decision metric w/ tier, region, model_slug (bounded)

overload.breaker_open	circuit breaker open	routing/control plane	Breaker OPEN for (model, region, tier) based on sustained overload signals + hysteresis/cooldown	Regional brownout; pool saturation persists; capacity signal indicates unstable service	503	server_error	true	yes	3–15	Respect Retry-After; attempt fallback region/model if configured; avoid tight loops	Yes (routing may select fallback if allowed; otherwise return this)	Smart Routing (Platform) + SRE thresholds	Emit breaker_state_transition; include breaker_key hash; avoid high-cardinality labels

overload.capacity_unavailable	no eligible capacity	routing/control plane	No eligible pool after applying constraints (tier, model pinning, safety, policy); fallback not possible/disabled	All compatible pools saturated; customer pinned model/region; Dedicated capacity exhausted	503	server_error	true	yes	5–30	Back off more aggressively; consider enabling fallback policy or using Dedicated; contact support if persistent	Sometimes (if policy allows; this code implies none was available at decision time)	Smart Routing (Platform)	Track route/model/region breakdown; should be distinguishable from breaker_open

overload.queue_full	runtime queue full	runtime/data plane	Bounded queue reached hard cap (pre-enqueue or at enqueue)	GPU pool hot; burst of requests; scheduler can’t accept new work	429	rate_limit_error	true	yes	1–3	Retry with jitter; lower parallelism; prefer smaller batch sizes	No (request already assigned to runtime; fallback not applied at this point)	Serving Runtime	Must include shed_reason=queue_full; record queue_depth, queue_limit at shed point

overload.scheduler_backpressure	scheduler backpressure	runtime/data plane	Shed at scheduling boundary (prefill/decode) due to backpressure/latency risk	Long-context requests cause decode backlog; streaming mix causes fairness issues	429	rate_limit_error	true	yes	1–5	Retry with jitter; consider shorter max_tokens; reduce streaming concurrency	No	Serving Runtime	Record stage=prefill|decode; include concurrency + token backlog gauges (sampled)

overload.memory_pressure	memory pressure / KV cache	runtime/data plane	KV-cache pressure / memory watermark exceeded; risk of thrash/OOM	Many long contexts; high batch size; fragmentation; sudden model mix change	503	server_error	true	yes	5–30	Retry later; reduce context length; reduce max_tokens; consider smaller model / quant profile	No	Serving Runtime	Track kv_cache_utilization + mem_pressure_level; do NOT expose host/GPU IDs in responses

overload.stream_interrupted	stream interrupted after start	runtime/data plane + egress	Overload after headers sent / stream started; must terminate stream (best-effort to avoid)	Client opens many streams; load spikes mid-stream; runtime forces shed	503	server_error	true	no (headers already sent)	n/a	Treat as retryable; client should reconnect w/ backoff; ensure idempotency (customer-side) if replaying prompts	No	Serving Runtime + Gateway	Emit stream_termination_reason=overload; include bytes_sent/tokens_sent (internal only)

TAB: Error Payload + Header Expectations
(Reference only; actual formats live in ADR-0147 + SDK docs)

Case	Endpoint type	Status	Body shape	Must include	Notes
Non-streaming overload	Redwood REST	429/503	{"error": {"message":..., "type":"overload", "code":"overload.*", "retryable":true}, "request_id":...}	X-Redwood-Error-Code, X-Redwood-Retryable, Retry-After	Do not include high-cardinality details (hostnames, GPU IDs)
Non-streaming overload	OpenAI-compat	429/503	{"error": {"message":..., "type":"rate_limit_error" or "server_error", "param": null, "code":"overload.*"}}	Retry-After + X-Redwood-Error-Code	429 uses type=rate_limit_error for client-library compatibility even though it may be shedding (not quota)
Streaming overload after start	Redwood streaming	(HTTP already 200)	Terminal error chunk w/ code overload.stream_interrupted	request_id in initial headers; terminal error chunk contains code	Retry-After cannot be sent if headers already flushed
Streaming overload after start	OpenAI SSE	(HTTP already 200)	SSE data: {"error": {..., "code":"overload.stream_interrupted"}} then close	SSE terminal event + X-Request-Id (initial)	Client should treat disconnect+terminal error as retryable w/ backoff

TAB: Retry Guidance (Support/Docs Alignment)
- If X-Redwood-Retryable=true and Retry-After present: wait Retry-After, then apply jitter (±20%) and exponential backoff on subsequent failures.
- Recommended max retries (non-normative): 3–5 for interactive traffic; fewer for batch jobs depending on job SLA.
- Avoid retry storms:
  - Do not retry immediately on 429/503 without honoring Retry-After.
  - Ensure jitter is present (we have seen clients synchronize and amplify spikes).

TAB: Layer Precedence (for choosing a single primary overload code)
Preferred precedence when multiple conditions are true (per ADR guidance; can be refined):
1) overload.breaker_open
2) overload.capacity_unavailable
3) overload.memory_pressure
4) overload.queue_full
5) overload.edge_admission_denied
(If streaming already started: overload.stream_interrupted)

TAB: Notes / Open Questions
- Dedicated alignment: Dedicated may still emit overload.* codes, but thresholds + expectations differ; confirm whether Dedicated uses 429 vs 503 in edge cases (tracked separately).
- Billing/metering: overload.* responses should not be billed as completed work; stream_interrupted policy is “do not bill partial output” unless product explicitly documents otherwise.
- Fallback visibility: this sheet does not cover “fallback applied” non-error behavior; might need a separate signal in console/metrics.

Change log:
2025-11-19 (RM): initial matrix seeded from ADR-0147 draft.
2025-11-22 (BM): aligned OpenAI-compat type mapping + required headers.
2025-12-12 (CW): added scheduler_backpressure vs queue_full distinction.
2026-01-09 (RM): added precedence tab + streaming Retry-After caveat.
